title: snack config set payload
description: The `data` of a `snack config set --json` document. Version 2 of the envelope renamed the `storage` keys to the snake_case every other payload uses. Frozen at 0.9: a field here does not disappear or change meaning without a major release, and a consumer must tolerate fields added by a later minor.

value.description: The value as it was stored, read back from the written configuration.

storage.description: What opening storage had to do, since `config set` is also the command that migrates a database.

applied.description: Migration numbers applied by this run, in order.
